extension.summary: Emulates a Plex Media Server, serving your Kodi library to Plex apps.
extension.description: PKBridge runs a local service that pretends to be a Plex Media Server. Plex apps on your network discover it automatically and can browse, search, and stream your Kodi library — movies, TV shows, and music — as if it were a real Plex server. No Plex account or Plex Media Server required.
